description: One of the defining elements of my career over the last many years is a commitment to investing in and sustaining our rural way of life in South Dakota, which includes protecting access to rural health care. It is one of the reasons I decided to run for Congress. The “Big Beautiful Bill” included an investment in rural health care that is reason for both optimism and a concern we could let an historic opportunity pass us by. Let me back up to explain what I mean. The “Big Beautiful Bill” passed
title: We Need a Long-Term Commitment to Rural Health Care
